content: LiteFS (docs.fly.io + superfly/litefs ARCHITECTURE.md): FUSE filesystem replicating SQLite across nodes; single primary accepts writes, replicas are read-only and eventually consistent (async LTX transaction application); primary election via Consul session leases (time-based, automatic failover among candidates) or static lease (fixed primary, tolerates primary downtime by leaving cluster read-only); LRU page cache for replicas; import/export commands (litefs import/export, mount); no writes possible during loss of lease - a split brain means no primary, not two primaries.
